prompt:
I've been running an AI assistant for several months and I have a batch of raw session transcripts sitting in logs/raw/ inside my workspace. I also have some older, partially-written daily memory files in memory/. I need you to go through all these session transcripts, properly organize everything into the memory system's daily note files (one per session date), and then produce an up-to-date long-term profile saved as MEMORY.md at the root of the workspace.

A few things I know happened that need to be reflected:
- I explicitly asked the assistant to forget my interest in Rust at some point.
- My Lodestar project was paused.
- I started a brand new top-priority project called Helix that is outcome-critical.
- I confirmed I strongly prefer dark mode in all tools.
- I asked the assistant to never store my company name.

The reference files under references/ explain the format and rules the memory system uses. Please also clean up any outdated assumptions that have gone stale based on the dates involved — today is 2025-03-15.
